ideas.title: Grow Crops for Inmates 🥕
ideas.hook: You run the prison garden. Grow crops in the yard, cook them into meals, and keep the inmates fed before the riot meter fills.
core_loop: Plant seeds in your yard plot
Water and harvest between guard shifts
Serve meals to hungry inmates for cash
Buy bigger plots and rarer seeds
Unlock new cell blocks with pickier inmates
ideas.twist: Rare crops can be smuggled to inmates for big payouts, but a guard patrol may confiscate them and drop your reputation.
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm + Prison / police is the second-biggest gap in the data (score 4.45). Grow / farm is the top rising mechanic at 1.87 (up 0.37 this week, 57 new games, 230,858 CCU) led by Throw a Seed (43,895). Prison / police is rising at 1.36 (up 0.21) with 13 Days to Escape [ALPHA] (29,851) and (🚨) Prison Tycoon (13,903).
ideas.differentiator: Prison games are about escaping or guarding; here you keep the place calm by farming, which no tracked game does.

ideas.title: +1 Gear Per Step ⚙️
ideas.hook: Every step you take bolts one more gear onto your robot. Walk to grow from a tiny tin bot into a towering mech, then stomp other players.
core_loop: Walk to gain +1 gear per step
Gears grow your robot's size and power
Enter the smash ring to knock out smaller bots
Rebirth to unlock new robot bodies
Climb the size leaderboard
ideas.twist: Bigger robots move slower, so small fast bots can still trip giants in the ring.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action + Robots / mechs is a gap at score 4.07. The +1 mechanic sits at 1.66 momentum (44 new games, 149,212 CCU) with +1 Venom Evolution (18,792) and +1 Boxing Battle Evolution (11,513); the "+1 ___" title formula is at 1.68. Robots / mechs is rising at 1.77 with [🛸] Sweep The Moon 🌕 (15,112) and RoChess! (8,317).
ideas.differentiator: +1 games usually grow a body or speed stat; this one builds a visible machine piece by piece and uses it in PvP.

ideas.title: Paint Dinos to Tame 🦕
ideas.hook: Wild dinosaurs roam a jungle valley. Splash them with the right paint pattern to tame them, then ride your painted herd in races.
core_loop: Explore the valley and spot wild dinos
Paint the pattern each species likes to tame it
Ride tamed dinos in valley races
Win paint colours and rarer species
Fill the dino index
ideas.twist: Your paint job is not just cosmetic: colours change a dino's stats, so the best racers wear the strangest patterns.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create + Dinosaurs (score 1.99) and Race / drive + Dinosaurs (1.55) are both thin gaps with no game filling them. Paint / create is at 1.52 momentum (32 new games, 88,426 CCU) with [📝UPD]⚽ Be a Soccer Legend (15,179); stylized art is rising at 1.35 led by [🐜] Ant Evolution (42,738), which shows creature worlds pulling players.
ideas.differentiator: Dino games are about survival or hatching; here creativity is the taming tool and the ride stats.

ideas.title: Outrun the Artillery 💣
ideas.hook: Shells are coming. Sprint from trench to trench across a battlefield before each barrage lands, digging new cover as you go.
core_loop: Wait for the siren, then sprint to the next trench
Dig cover with your shovel between barrages
Reach the bunker to bank cash
Buy faster boots and better shovels
Unlock longer, harder fronts
ideas.twist: Craters from earlier shells change the course every round, so no two runs are the same.
ideas.why_now: Escape / run + Military / war is a gap at score 3.27. Military / war is rising at 1.62 (up 0.46 this week, 20 new games, 113,699 CCU) with Voxel Wars (34,887). Interiors-and-escape still pull: 13 Days to Escape [ALPHA] has 29,851 CCU and [UPD] Stop The Tsunami! has 26,874. Voxel / blocky art is the fastest-rising style at 2.40.
ideas.differentiator: Military games on Roblox are shooters; this turns war into a hazard run you survive, not a fight you win.

ideas.title: Roll Giant Dice 🎲
ideas.hook: Push a dice the size of a house off a cliff. Whatever face lands up multiplies your cash, and the whole server watches it tumble.
core_loop: Push your giant dice to the cliff edge
Launch it and watch it bounce
Earn cash times the face it lands on
Buy heavier dice with more faces
Unlock bigger cliffs
ideas.twist: Dice can smash into other players' dice mid-roll and flip their result, so timing your launch matters.
ideas.why_now: Dice / cards + Giant / huge is a gap at score 3.18. Dice / cards is rising at 1.13 (13 new games) with [⚡] Steal a Superpower! (11,460). Giant / huge is at 1.75 with [🚗 UPD 3] Be The Biggest Streamer (22,544) and [🛒] Raise The Biggest Family (18,337). Physics Sim is the top rising sub-genre at 2.60, led by Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (132,853).
ideas.differentiator: Dice games use flat UI rolls; here the roll is a physics event players can watch and mess with.

ideas.title: Draw Ice Over Lava 🧊
ideas.hook: The floor is lava. Draw lines with your ice pen and they freeze into bridges, but they melt fast, so keep drawing and keep running.
core_loop: Draw an ice path across the lava
Run it before it melts
Collect gems on each stage
Buy longer ice ink and colder pens
Reach the volcano top
ideas.twist: Thicker lines last longer but use more ink, so players learn to draw short smart paths.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create + Ice / fire / elements is a gap at score 2.90. Paint / create is at 1.52 momentum (32 new games, 88,426 CCU) with [PvP] Ragdoll Wars! (8,364). Runners are rising at 1.57 with DONT SPLASH (33,107), and the Disaster / weather theme sits at 2.38 with [UPD] Stop The Tsunami! (26,874).
ideas.differentiator: Drawing games are usually guess-or-judge; here the drawing is your only floor.

ideas.title: Jet Ski Joust 🌊
ideas.hook: Race jet skis across the bay holding a padded lance. Knock rivals into the water as you pass them and ragdoll them across the waves.
core_loop: Pick a lane and launch your jet ski
Line up rivals and swing your lance
Ragdolled riders lose the lap
Win cash and buy faster skis and longer lances
Unlock new bays
ideas.twist: Hits that land at top speed send riders flying farther, so racing and fighting feed each other.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch + Race / drive is the second-strongest pair in the data (9 new games, 190,425 CCU). Hit / swing is at 1.62 with Realistic Ragdoll MMA 🥊 (25,794); Race / drive at 1.18 with BloxNG [CRASH PHYSICS] 💥 (48,490). Ocean / pirates is rising at 1.34 (up 0.19) with [🐟] Fish For Sea Animals (24,022).
ideas.differentiator: Racing games avoid contact; here contact is the point, and water makes every hit a show.

ideas.title: Shoot Asteroids for Gold 🪐
ideas.hook: Asteroids drift past your space station. Blast them apart with mining lasers and collect the gold chunks before they float away.
core_loop: Aim your laser at passing asteroids
Break them into ore chunks
Tractor-beam the gold back to your station
Sell ore and upgrade lasers
Unlock deeper asteroid belts
ideas.twist: Rare golden asteroids appear for the whole server at once and the biggest damage-dealer gets the core.
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig + Shooter is a strong pair (4 new games, 145,455 CCU). Break / mine is at 1.67 with [WORLD 2] Sandworm Playground (20,684); Space is the top rising theme at 2.47 with [🛸] Sweep The Moon 🌕 (15,112). Money / rich is at 1.76 (up 0.22) with Throw a Seed (43,895).
ideas.differentiator: Mining games use pickaxes on the ground; here mining is aiming, and the ore moves.

ideas.title: Grow Soldiers for War 🪖
ideas.hook: Plant soldier seeds on your farm. They sprout into toy troops, and you march your harvest across the field to fight the farm next door.
core_loop: Plant soldier seeds in your field
Grow them into troops (bigger plots, bigger soldiers)
Send squads to raid other farms
Win seeds and supplies from victories
Unlock tanks and generals as rare crops
ideas.twist: Each soldier type needs different weather to grow, so planning your field matters as much as fighting.
ideas.why_now: Fight / battle + Grow / farm is a live pair (9 new games, 75,959 CCU). Grow / farm leads rising mechanics at 1.87 (up 0.37); Military / war is rising at 1.62 (up 0.46) with [🌾 HARVEST EVENT] Summon a Pet Army 🐲 (14,940) and [DRAGONFLY] Raise an Ant Colony 🐜 (11,061), showing army-growing works.
inspired_by: [🌾 HARVEST EVENT] Summon a Pet Army 🐲
ideas.differentiator: Army games summon or hatch; growing troops as crops adds a farm loop to the war.

ideas.title: Roll Dice, Cast Spells 🧙
ideas.hook: Wizard duels where you roll for your spell. Every turn you throw magic dice and the faces decide whether you cast a fireball, a shield or a frog curse.
core_loop: Join a duel in the castle arena
Roll your spell dice
Cast what you rolled at your rival
Win coins to buy new dice faces
Rank up through wizard tiers
ideas.twist: You build your own dice, so a risky player can fill them with huge spells and blank faces.
ideas.why_now: Dice / cards + Fantasy / medieval is a gap at score 2.95. Fantasy / medieval is rising at 1.58 (up 0.47 this week) with [⚔️] Kit PVP FFA (27,745) and Dragon Arena (14,348). Battlegrounds & Fighting is up 0.36 this week to 1.20.
ideas.differentiator: Fantasy fighters rely on skill combos; luck dice let new players win right away.
